cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.lightning.des: Calls the Zeus to summon the Lightning nearby because you two are buddies, of course.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.reset_village: Use with an emerald in other hand while looking at a villager to erase its memory (job, level, offers) and save it onto the emerald, which can then be restored onto any villager (but a nitwit) with a right click.
You must hold a regular emerald in your other hand!
There doesn't seem much to wipe from this villager's head...
There are no entities in your reach!
Try using this on a villager!
This villager seems like too much of a NITWIT to even have a job...
It seems this Memory Emerald is... empty? Where did you even get it?

Can't place a spectral bed that far away!
Can't fit a spectral bed there!
Can't place a spectral bed on there!
In this dimension, spectral beds can only be placed at night or during thunderstorms!
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.devour.desc: Consumes the item in your other hand, sometimes even if it is normally not consumable. Devour allows you to eat items like totem of undying or shulker shell, so that you get unpredictable effects.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.devour.noitem: No item to consume in the other hand
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.devour.badite: Can't eat the item in the other hand
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_boat: Summons a spectral boat at the targeted point. The boat has a chest that is shared with your Spectral Donkey's! Despawns if not interacted with for some time.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_donk: Summons a spectral donkey, whose inventory is shared with your Spectral Boat's chest! Despawns if not interacted with for some time.
Can't summon a spectral donkey that far away!
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.empower_damag: Applies a stacking damage buff effect to yourself.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.empower_mana_: Applies a stacking mana cost buff effect to yourself.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.empower_cantr: Applies a stacking cantrip buff effect to yourself. The effect is reserved for empowering other cantrips later.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_armo: Summons a powerful Spectral armor set! With Great Power, comes Greater Spectral Defence. Taking it off however will shred it into pieces.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_slim: Summons a small friendly spectral slime. It follows you from a distance and fights hostile creatures.
Coaxes a sapling into a full tree, or urges an existing tree to grow taller and branch out into an old-growth giant.
Can't find a tree to grow!
This poor tree is too damaged to be grown!
This tree's roots are destroyed, it can't grow taller
The tree stretches a little taller.
A new branch bursts from the trunk!

cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.bubble_up.des: Rapidly floats you up out of the water like a dolphin. Can only be cast while submerged deeper than two blocks under water
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.bubble_up.not: You should be in water to cast Bubble Up!

dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.intro: Oh! A traveler! *Cough, cough* Halt there, traveler. It has been decades since anyone stumbled into this forgotten sanctum. The dust settles heavily on those who lack a purpose.
I am a very Old Wizard. I manipulate the raw, volatile syntax of the cosmos - what your kind calls 'magic'.
I sense a faint spark of attunement within you, though it is currently buried under immense ignorance.
Tell me, stranger... do you seek to bend the elements to your will, or will you scurry back to the safety of the mundane world?
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.not_r: Hah! Ye walk in here like ye own the place, but I don't sense a single spell ever crackled from yer fingertips. Come back when ye've actually *cast* somethin', even if it's just a spark. Then we'll talk.
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.fallb: Ya travelers, never know what they sayin'
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.back_: Ah... it's you again. Or is it? Forgive me, the centuries tend to blur faces together like rain on parchment.
Yes, yes, the spark from before. Let us skip the pleasantries and get back to business.
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.cantr: Speak up then. Which thread of the arcane do you wish to unravel today?
Ye already know all th' patterns to do this spell... Why not try it? Don't get cold feet now, young'un!
Ye already know this spell well enough... What, just wanted to show off? Haha.

Ah, hold on there, young'un. *Squints* Yer hands are still dusty from the last offering ye brought me today. Patience! Even an old wizard's memory needs a day to digest a gift. Come back tomorrow, when the sun's climbed a bit higher, and we'll try again.
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.wrong: Hmph! That ain't what I asked for. Me old eyes may be cloudy, but they ain't that cloudy. Try again, young'un.
dialogue.forgotten_cantrips.wizard.cantr: Alrighty then, I'll try teaching ya. But y'see, my memory isn't what it used to be, I forget how to even shape mana for this spell, haha... Maybe I'd be able to cast it again if ye brought me some %s.
Good job, young'un! This will surely help... Think I got th' first pattern down now. Come back later if ya want to continue this.
Ah, right. Hmm, let's see here... Think I'd remember more of the spell with some %s. Up for th' task, young'un?
Ah, great, great... Think I remember the second pattern now. Come back soon, we've almost figured this out...
Right, right... We're almost to the finish line. Now I just need a single %s, and I think I'll finally be able to teach ya!
Exquisite work, young'un! Now, let me work my magic, and... aha!
Hmm... I'd say this is a really useful spell... if you want to turn your pigs into zombies and make those green exploding creatures extra deadly, that is... What d'ya say?
Hmm... Now this might be a useful skill if you spend many nights in the wild, hiding from th' monsters in ditches and dugouts. What d'ya say?
Want to sail the high seas but don't got enough gold to buy a frigate? Think this spell might help ya.
Y'know what they say... May your heart rejoice like a man who has four donkeys to yoke. Interested, young'un?
I bet a traveler's armor takes quite a beating every now and then... Must be annoying to patch it up all the time, eh? Ever thought about defending y'self with magic instead?
Gonna be honest here, this one isn't so useful. But, if ya ever wanted to keep one of those jumpy green blobs as a pet, I think ya'd like this.
Ever get so carried away plundering treasure on the sea floor that you forget to breathe? I might just know how t' help. Just be careful not to get the bends, haha.
A bunch'a weak strikes, however many times you repeat 'em, may never be able to make strong enemies budge. But if ya were to put your all into one massive blow, oh ho ho... Sounds interesting to ya?
If there's any one thing I learned in my centuries of life, issat there ain't such a thing as too much mana.
What, these spells are too weak for ya? ...They could be, t'be honest. Want a way around this conundrum?
chat.forgotten_cantrips.locked: Your Tier to learn this is too low
